title: Converge reader composition roots
summary: Make accepted reader routes declare content, URL state, lifecycle, rendering, conformance, and review metadata through shared inferred contracts instead of duplicating page and application policy.
expectedLearning: Whether one inferred route and lifecycle composition contract can serve equation and equation-area readers without erasing renderer-specific motion.
Whether route, conformance, contact-sheet, and build metadata can share one source while remaining tree-shakeable.
allowedWork: Reader compiler page shells, build-time route manifests, typed URL codecs, browser lifecycle services, scroll clocks, frame schedulers, lesson runtime descriptors, production adapter integration, conformance descriptors, contact-sheet descriptors, impact selection, production closure, and bundle budgets.
Small compatibility refactors in the accepted equation and distribution readers required to consume shared composition contracts.
disallowedWork: Do not change accepted equation or distribution semantics, choreography, typography, color, layout, focus policy, URL meaning, searchable transcripts, or responsive behavior.
Do not implement branch scheduling, structured algebra, advanced fractions, LLM mutation, new tutorial subjects, WebGL breadth, or editor redesign.
Do not edit unrelated user-authored roadmap, thread, decision, or design documents.
